ICS 23.100.10MED 20Reaffirmed 20221. SCOPEThis Indian Standard specifies the requirements for monoset pumps (single/multi stage) using single/three phase a.c. induction motor/motor portion for handling clear, cold water for agricultural and water supply purposes.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All Standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
